title: 10 More and 10 Less
standard_text: 1.5C use relationships to determine the number that is 10 more and 10 less than a given number up to 120
meta_desc: Free Grade 1 worksheets for Texas TEKS 1.5C: find 10 more and 10 less with blocks, a hundred chart and stories. 100 questions with answers.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • 10 more: the tens digit goes up by 1. 34 → 44.
  • 10 less: the tens digit goes down by 1. 34 → 24.
  • The ones digit stays the same.
  • On a hundred chart, 10 more is the number just below.

Examples

Example

10 more than 38

3 tens → 4 tens

Answer: 48

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Changing the ones digitOnly the tens change.
Adding 1 instead of 1010 more than 38 is 48, not 39.
Going the wrong wayMore goes up; less goes down.

faq.q: Why does only the tens digit change?
faq.a: Adding or taking 1 ten does not change the ones.

items.e: 47 is 4 tens, 7 ones. Add 1 ten. Now you have 5 tens, 7 ones. That is 57.

items.e: 52 + 10 = 62. The 5 tens become 6 tens. The ones digit stays 2.

items.q: What number goes in the box? 14, 24, 34, ☐
items.e: Each number is 10 more than the one before. The tens digit goes up by 1. The ones digit stays 4. ☐ = 44.

items.e: 23 + 10 = 33. 33 + 10 = 43. Two jumps of 10 add 2 tens.

items.e: 10 more than 36 is 46. Only the tens digit goes up by 1.

items.q: 10 more than ☐ is 65. What number goes in the box?
items.e: Go back 1 ten from 65. 65 − 10 = 55. Check: 10 more than 55 is 65.

items.q: 10 less than ☐ is 30. What number goes in the box?

items.q: Leo has 46 stickers. He gets a pack of 10 more. How many stickers does he have now?
items.e: 46 + 10 = 56. 4 tens and 6 ones plus 1 ten is 5 tens and 6 ones.

items.q: There are 35 kids in the gym. 10 more kids come in. How many kids are in the gym now?
items.e: 35 + 10 = 45. The tens digit goes from 3 to 4.

items.q: A book has 72 pages. A thin book has 10 fewer pages. How many pages does the thin book have?
items.e: 10 fewer means 10 less. 72 − 10 = 62.

items.q: Ethan has 58 beads. He uses 10 beads to make a ring. How many beads are left?
items.e: 58 − 10 = 48. The ones digit stays 8.

items.q: A box has 64 crayons. A big box has 10 more crayons. How many crayons are in the big box?
A tree has 81 apples. 10 apples fall off. How many apples are on the tree now?
items.e: 81 − 10 = 71. 8 tens become 7 tens. The 1 one stays.

items.q: Noah is on page 23 of a book. He reads 10 more pages. What page is he on now?
items.e: 23 + 10 = 33. 2 tens become 3 tens.

items.q: A bus has 27 people on it. 10 people get off. How many people are still on the bus?
items.e: 27 − 10 = 17. 2 tens become 1 ten. The 7 ones stay.

items.q: Carlos jumps rope 66 times. Then he jumps 10 more times. How many jumps is that in all?
There are 90 marbles in a jar. Aaliyah takes out 10 marbles. How many marbles are in the jar now?
items.e: 90 − 10 = 80. 9 tens take away 1 ten is 8 tens.

items.q: Pencils come in boxes of 10. Emma has 61 pencils. She buys 1 more box. How many pencils does she have now?
items.e: 1 box is 10 pencils. 61 + 10 = 71.

items.q: Camila has 39 cents. She finds a dime. A dime is 10 cents. How many cents does she have now?
items.e: 39 + 10 = 49. Do not add just 1 cent: a dime is worth 10.

items.q: I am 10 less than 75. What number am I?
items.e: 75 is 7 tens, 5 ones. Take away 1 ten: 6 tens, 5 ones. I am 65.

items.q: I am 10 more than 49. What number am I?
items.e: 49 is 4 tens, 9 ones. Add 1 ten: 5 tens, 9 ones. I am 59.

items.q: A farm has 53 cows. It has 10 more sheep than cows. How many sheep are there?
items.e: 10 more than 53 is 63.

items.q: Sofia has 44 shells. Liam has 10 fewer shells than Sofia. How many shells does Liam have?
items.e: 10 fewer than 44 is 44 − 10 = 34.

items.q: Valeria makes 35 with 3 tens and 5 ones. She adds 1 ten. What number does she have now?
items.e: 3 tens and 1 more ten is 4 tens. 4 tens and 5 ones is 45.

items.q: A store has 7 packs of 10 eggs. It sells 1 pack. How many eggs are left?
items.e: 7 packs of 10 is 70 eggs. 1 pack is 10 eggs. 70 − 10 = 60.

items.q: Ava counts 28 birds in a tree. 10 birds fly away. How many birds are still in the tree?
items.e: 28 − 10 = 18. 2 tens become 1 ten.

items.q: Elijah had some cards. He got 10 more cards. Now he has 52 cards. How many cards did he have before?
items.e: Before means 10 less than now. 52 − 10 = 42. Check: 42 + 10 = 52.
